pnpm.//: Transitive-only security overrides. Every entry answers a Dependabot alert on a package nothing here declares directly, so there is no manifest to bump — the version has to be forced from the root. None of these reach a consumer: the published packages ship no runtime dependencies except @viu/emporix-mixins -> jiti. Drop an entry once the parent that pulls it has moved on by itself.
pnpm.packageExtensionsComment: next's bundled styled-jsx type definitions (next/dist/styled-jsx/types/*.d.ts) import "react" without next declaring @types/react. pnpm then resolves that from the single hoisted copy in .pnpm/node_modules, whichever major happens to win. That was harmless while the workspace held only React 19 types; examples/md-module now pins @types/react 18 (it must match the Management Dashboard's React 18 host), and the hoisted copy flipped to 18 — poisoning the global JSX namespace for every Next example with "'children' is missing in ReactElement but required in ReactPortal". Declaring the dependency makes next's resolution deterministic instead of dependent on what else is installed.
